definitions.gloss: to score a win; to chalk up a victory (originally from sumo, now used broadly in sports and competition)
definitions.explanation: to score a win; to chalk up a victory (originally from sumo, now used broadly in sports and competition)

examples.japanese: ⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白星|しろぼし}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: Scored a win on the first day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧{白星|しろぼし}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: The rookie player scored their first professional win.

examples.japanese: {五連敗|ごれんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、ようやく⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白星|しろぼし}を{挙|あ}げること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After five consecutive losses, the team was finally able to score a win.

notes:
Originates from sumo wrestling, where wins are marked with a white circle (⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧) and losses with a black circle (⟦{黒星|くろぼし}→黒星：19294_kuroboshi⟧) on the scoreboard. Now widely used in sports journalism and everyday conversation to mean winning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白星|しろぼし}を{挙|あ}げる — to score a win
- ⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧ — starting with a win
- ⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧⟦{発進|はっしん}→発進：29985_hasshin⟧ — winning start (in a tournament)
- ⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれない→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧ — to be unable to get a win

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}ち{星|ぼし} — win (in a win-loss record)
- ⟦{黒星|くろぼし}→黒星：19294_kuroboshi⟧ — loss; defeat (the opposite)
- {金星|きんぼし} — an upset win (in sumo, when a lower-ranked wrestler defeats a yokozuna; also used figuratively)
